critique: The two flat SVG rays, the large one tiled in a 160px Kente checker of vermilion, cobalt, emerald and cream diamonds with a yellow spine, read as woven cloth set loose on a pale #c4eee9 field, meeting the high-key, spare brief without falling back on glow or gloom. The pairings undercut each other, though: the 0.16-opacity shadows hang only about 200px below each ray in open water rather than on the reef, and the background video's photoreal maroon-and-yellow mantas swim in the bottom band, so cropped photographic rays compete with the woven ones. Drop or crop the video to the bare coral-and-sand floor, and pin both shadows down onto it so the slow glides actually sweep across the reef.
